menu_restless.role: restless wait, 19.2 s: sword low -> arms crossed with the blade on her shoulder -> leans on the planted blade, hand on hip, weight shifting -> sword low. Front-facing, stands still

menu_stretch.role: limbering up, 8.9 s: stretches the sword arm across her chest, one calm overhead swing, lowers it and rolls her shoulders

menu_ready.role: two-handed high guard swaying the blade side to side, 2.8 s (rare: a restrained ready beat)

menu_inspect.role: raises the blade upright before her and looks along it, 3.6 s (sword inspection)

menu_vigil.role: brings the blade up close before her face, a quiet vigil / salute, 3.7 s

menu_ease.role: lowers the sword to her side at ease, looks around, raises it back to guard, 7.6 s

menu_stance_2h.role: two-handed breathing guard, 3.6 s loop: the alternate home stance (subtle stance change)
